plan_search: Made November 6, 2026. Every case on the Kentucky Public Service Commission site whose title names an integrated resource plan (the commission's docket harvest in batches/us-ky/harvest/psc_dockets.json), each utility's own planning page, TVA's plan page, and a web search for a resource plan by every municipal utility and agency that owns a plant in the export. Municipal utilities and agencies do not file plans with the commission, so their plans are found on their own sites, in board packets or in local news.

utilities.sheet_note: The combined cycle in certificate case 2026-00324 replaces the 480 MW combustion turbine in the 2022 plan
Case 2026-00167 is a filing-date request for the next plan, not a new plan

utilities.utility: Louisville Gas and Electric Company and Kentucky Utilities Company

utilities.sheet_note: KYMEA is the Kentucky Municipal Energy Agency; the Kentucky Municipal Power Agency is a different agency (Paducah and Princeton). The plan also studies KYMEA Energy Center II (92 MW) and growing Energy Center I to 129 MW after 2029
The board approved the final plan in August 2026; it names no Kentucky site
Not on the tab yet. The 2026 plan recommends a 36 MW gas engine plant for 2030 and studies a 79 MW share of a larger combustion turbine plant in 2036

not_planners.Owensboro Municipal Utilities: Municipal utility, not filed with the commission. Its 2022 plan is a supply contract plan; an updated plan is under way as of 2026. The 545 MW gas plant studied for the Elmer Smith site is already in GEM (L100000103939). Recheck for the updated plan next cycle.
not_planners.Kentucky Municipal Power Agency: Paducah and Princeton's agency. No resource plan was found by web search on November 6, 2026. Paducah's peaking plant is in GEM (L100000402189). GEM also uses this name as the owner of KYMEA Energy Center I, which a question in this batch asks about.
not_planners.Paducah Power System Co: Member of the Kentucky Municipal Power Agency; no plan of its own was found by web search on November 6, 2026.
not_planners.Indiana Municipal Power Agency: Part owner of Trimble County coal unit 2; its plan is filed in Indiana and is read in the Indiana batch.
not_planners.Illinois Municipal Elec Agency: Part owner of Trimble County coal unit 2; its plan covers Illinois and is read in the Illinois batch.
not_planners.Black Stallion Energy Center LLC: Project company of a cancelled coal plant, not a utility.
not_planners.Middle River Power II LLC: Independent power producer, files no resource plan.
not_planners.NRG Energy Inc: Independent power producer, files no resource plan.
not_planners.Green River East GenCo LLC: Project company for the Elmer Smith gas plant, not a utility.
